recipes.name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Tall, tender pancakes with golden edges — the Sunday-morning classic.
ingredients: Melted butter, plus extra for the pan
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt together in a large bowl.
In a jug, whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter until smooth.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and fold gently until just combined. A few lumps are fine — overmixing makes pancakes tough.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes while you heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush it with butter.
Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles appear on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook for another minute until golden. Keep warm while you cook the rest.
Stack high and serve with maple syrup and fresh berries.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide, deep pan over medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli flakes and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make 5 small wells in the sauce with a spoon and crack an egg into each one.
Cover and cook on low heat for 5–8 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Scatter with herbs and serve straight from the pan with bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Berry Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Creamy, no-cook oats you prep the night before and grab in the morning.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt, chia seeds, honey and vanilla together in a bowl.
Divide between two jars, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
In the morning, give each jar a stir and loosen with a splash of milk if it's too thick.
Top with berries and an extra drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Chilli Eggs
recipes.description: Crunchy sourdough, zesty smashed avocado and crispy-edged fried eggs.
steps: Toast the sourdough until deeply golden.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the eggs until the edges are crisp and the yolks are how you like them.
Spread the avocado thickly on the toast, top each slice with an egg and finish with chilli flakes.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Tender marinated chicken in a silky, gently spiced tomato and butter sauce.
steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, half the ginger-garlic paste and 1 tsp salt. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a large pan over high heat and sear the chicken in batches until browned but not cooked through. Set aside.
Lower the heat, melt the butter and cook the onion for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the remaining ginger-garlic paste, garam masala and the chilli powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the passata and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often, until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan and simmer for 8–10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the cream, sugar and crushed fenugreek leaves. Simmer 2 more minutes, taste for salt, and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
recipes.description: Golden, crackling skin and juicy meat, perfumed with lemon, garlic and thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Take the chicken out of the fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Pat the chicken completely dry. Mix the butter with the leaves from 3 thyme sprigs and rub it all over and under the breast skin.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon halves, half the garlic and the remaining thyme. Season generously.
Toss the potatoes and remaining garlic with the olive oil and salt in a roasting tin, then sit the chicken on top.
Roast for about 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear when the thigh is pierced (75°C inside).
Rest the chicken, loosely covered, for 15 minutes while the potatoes crisp up in the oven. Carve and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned chicken glazed in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce.
ingredients: Steamed rice, sesame seeds, spring onions
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger together to make the sauce.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken skin-side down and cook for 6–7 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook for another 5 minutes until cooked through. Wipe out excess fat.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble for 1 minute, then stir in the cornflour mix.
Turn the chicken in the sauce until thick and glossy, about 1–2 minutes.
Slice, spoon over the glaze and serve on rice with sesame seeds and spring onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Wraps
recipes.description: Warmly spiced chicken, garlic yoghurt sauce and crunchy pickles, all wrapped up.
steps: Mix the olive oil, lemon juice, spices, two-thirds of the garlic and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Stir the remaining garlic and a pinch of salt into the yoghurt for the sauce.
Cook the chicken in a hot griddle or frying pan for 5–6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with garlic yoghurt, pile on chicken and salad, and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Classic Smash Burgers
recipes.description: Thin, crispy-edged patties with melty cheese on soft toasted buns.
steps: Divide the mince into 8 loose balls — don't pack them tightly.
Toast the cut sides of the buns in a dry pan until golden. Set aside.
Heat a heavy pan or cast-iron skillet until smoking hot.
Add 2 balls, top each with a little sliced onion, then press down hard with a spatula until very thin. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook for 2 minutes until a deep brown crust forms, flip, add cheese to half the patties and cook 1 more minute.
Stack two patties per bun and finish with your favourite toppings.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Velvety strips of beef and crisp broccoli in a savoury garlic-ginger sauce.
ingredients: Flank or sirloin steak, thinly sliced
steps: Toss the beef with the cornflour and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy, oyster sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water for the sauce.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over very high heat. Sear the beef in a single layer for 1 minute per side, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the broccoli and sauce. Toss for 1–2 minutes until glossy and hot. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chilli con Carne
recipes.description: A rich, smoky, slow-simmered chilli that tastes even better the next day.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and pepper for 7 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Turn up the heat, add the mince and break it up. Cook until browned all over.
Stir in the spices, oregano and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and stock, season well and bring to a simmer.
Cover partially and simmer gently for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the kidney beans and cook 10 minutes more. Serve with rice, a dollop of sour cream and coriander.

recipes.name: Crispy Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Seasoned beef in crunchy shells with fresh salsa, cheese and lime.
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a hot pan for 8 minutes, breaking up the meat.
Stir in the spices and tomato paste with 100 ml water. Simmer for 5 minutes until saucy. Season.
Mix the tomatoes and coriander with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt for a quick salsa.
Warm the taco shells in the oven for 3 minutes.
Fill the shells with beef, then top with salsa, cheese and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Prawns
recipes.description: Juicy prawns sizzled in garlicky lemon butter — ready in under 20 minutes.
steps: Pat the prawns dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the prawns in a single layer and cook for 1–2 minutes per side until pink. Remove to a plate.
Lower the heat, add the remaining butter, garlic and chilli and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Return the prawns, add the lemon juice and parsley, and toss to coat. Serve right away.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Baked Salmon
recipes.description: Flaky salmon fillets under a sticky, tangy honey-mustard glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a baking tray.
Mix both mustards, honey, olive oil and garlic.
Place the salmon on the tray, season lightly and spread the glaze over the top.
Bake for 12–14 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve with green beans or a crisp salad.

recipes.name: Coconut Fish Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant South Indian-style curry with tender white fish in coconut milk.
steps: Rub the fish with the turmeric and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
Heat the coconut oil, add the mustard seeds and let them pop, then add the curry leaves.
Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until golden. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and chillies for 1 minute.
Add the ground spices and tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and tamarind, season and bring to a gentle simmer.
Slide in the fish and simmer for 6–8 minutes without stirring too much, until just cooked. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Sesame-soy salmon over rice with crunchy veg, avocado and a spicy mayo drizzle.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook according to the packet. Let it cool slightly.
Toss the salmon with the soy sauce, sesame oil and rice vinegar. Chill for 10 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha for the spicy mayo.
Divide the rice between bowls and arrange the salmon, avocado, cucumber and carrot on top.
Drizzle with spicy mayo and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Hearty chickpeas in a tangy, deeply spiced onion-tomato gravy.
steps: Heat the oil and toast the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onions and cook for 10 minutes until deep golden — this builds the flavour.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and green chilli for 1 minute, then the ground coriander, chilli powder and turmeric.
Add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates at the edges, about 6 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and 300 ml water. Mash a few chickpeas to thicken, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, amchur and salt to taste. Scatter with coriander and serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.description: Smoky, savoury fried rice loaded with veg — the best use of yesterday's rice.
steps: Break up any clumps in the cold rice with your fingers.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat, scramble the eggs until just set, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and the whites of the spring onions. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the peas, carrots and pepper and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and spread it out. Let it sit for 1 minute to toast, then toss. Repeat for 3–4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper and eggs. Toss well and finish with the green spring onions.

recipes.name: Village Greek Salad
recipes.description: Juicy tomatoes, crisp cucumber, olives and a slab of feta — no lettuce needed.
steps: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion in a wide bowl. Season with salt and toss.
Scatter over the olives.
Lay the feta on top in one piece.
Drizzle with the olive oil and vinegar, sprinkle with oregano and serve with bread to mop up the juices.

recipes.name: Crispy Falafel
recipes.description: Herby, crunchy chickpea fritters made the traditional way with soaked dried chickpeas.
steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas well — never use canned chickpeas, or the falafel will fall apart.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic and herbs in a food processor until finely chopped but not a paste.
Mix in the spices, salt and baking powder. Chill for 15 minutes.
Shape into small patties or balls, about 2 tbsp each.
Heat 5 cm of oil to 175°C and fry in batches for 3–4 minutes until deep golden. Drain on paper.
Serve hot in pita with tahini sauce and salad.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Five ingredients, fifteen minutes: garlic, chilli and olive oil at their finest.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until just shy of al dente. Save a mug of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently heat the oil and garlic in a large pan over low heat until the garlic is pale gold, about 4 minutes.
Add the chilli flakes and take the pan off the heat.
Transfer the pasta to the pan with a splash of pasta water.
Toss vigorously over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until the sauce turns silky and clings to the pasta.
Stir through the parsley and serve with parmesan if you like.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Penne
recipes.description: A velvety pink sauce of tomatoes, garlic and cream that kids and grown-ups love.
steps: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente. Reserve a little pasta water.
Heat the oil and cook the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream and parmesan and season.
Toss in the penne with a splash of pasta water until glossy. Tear over the basil to serve.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: The Roman classic: silky egg and cheese sauce, crisp cured meat, lots of black pepper — no cream.
ingredients: Guanciale, pancetta or turkey bacon, diced
steps: Whisk the yolks, whole egg, both cheeses and the pepper together in a bowl.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water. Save a mug of pasta water.
Meanwhile, fry the guanciale in a large pan over medium heat until crisp and the fat has rendered. Turn off the heat.
Add the drained pasta to the pan and toss in the fat. Let it cool for 1 minute so the eggs don't scramble.
Pour in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water and toss quickly until creamy. Add more water if needed.
Serve at once with extra cheese and pepper.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta with Blistered Tomatoes
recipes.description: Homemade basil pesto tossed with pasta and sweet, burst cherry tomatoes.
steps: Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and a pinch of salt. With the motor running, pour in most of the oil until smooth.
Cook the pasta in salted water. Reserve a little pasta water.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan over high heat and cook the tomatoes until blistered and bursting, about 5 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta with the pesto and a splash of pasta water off the heat.
Fold in the tomatoes, add a squeeze of lemon and serve.

recipes.name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: Oven-roasted tomatoes blended into a sweet, velvety soup. Perfect with a grilled cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Spread the tomatoes, onion and garlic on a tray, drizzle with oil and season. Roast for 35 minutes until soft and caramelised.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins and tip everything into a pot with the stock.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then add the basil and blend until smooth.
Season to taste and swirl in the cream if using.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Golden broth, tender chicken and soft noodles — a bowl of pure comfort.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, add the whole chicken pieces and thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Lift it out and shred with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook until tender, about 6 minutes.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and stir in the parsley.

recipes.name: Turkish Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Mercimek çorbası: a silky, lemony lentil soup finished with a sizzling paprika butter.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock, bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend until smooth and season well. Add water if too thick.
Melt the butter until foaming, stir in the paprika and drizzle over each bowl. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Hearty Minestrone
recipes.description: A chunky Italian vegetable soup with beans and little pasta.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10 minutes until soft.
Add the courgettes and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, season and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook until the pasta is tender, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the greens until wilted. Serve with parmesan and torn basil.

recipes.name: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Crisp edges, soft chewy centres and puddles of melted chocolate.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays with baking paper.
Whisk the melted butter with both sugars until glossy, then beat in the egg, yolk and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, baking soda and salt until just combined, then the chocolate.
Scoop 18 balls onto the trays, well spaced.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the tray for 5 minutes — they firm up as they cool.

recipes.name: Easy Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist, deeply banana-y loaf — the tastiest way to use up spotty bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (155°C fan) and line a 900 g loaf tin.
Mash the bananas in a bowl, then stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla, then the baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Fold in the flour (and walnuts) until no dry streaks remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 55–65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then on a rack before slicing.

recipes.name: Cardamom Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy, slow-cooked rice pudding in the style of kheer, scented with cardamom.
steps: Soak the rice in water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Bring the milk to the boil in a heavy pot, add the rice and cardamom, and lower to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 35–40 minutes, stirring often so it doesn't catch, until the rice is very soft and the milk has thickened.
Stir in the sugar and saffron and cook for 5 more minutes.
Serve warm or chilled, topped with pistachios and almonds.

recipes.name: No-Bake Cheesecake Jars
recipes.description: Buttery biscuit base, tangy vanilla cream cheese and a quick strawberry topping.
steps: Crush the biscuits into crumbs and mix with the melted butter. Press into the bottom of 4 small jars or glasses.
Beat the cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold it into the cream cheese mixture.
Spoon over the biscuit bases and chill for at least 1 hour.
Toss the strawberries with the honey and spoon on top just before serving.
